dedupe_keys.name: somaliland health facilities lacking adequate access to electricity

description: Somaliland - Health Facilities Lacking Adequate Access To Electricity is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access", published or maintained by Min Jaegal (World Bank Group). This dataset,used for the SESRP project, contains the information on health facilities lacking adequate access to electricity in Somaliland. Coverage: Somalia. It has 2 files in ZIP, GeoJSON. The portal files it under Energy access. The portal gives 2022 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
